errors.evidence: The labels on the y-axis are spaced every 2 units (0, 2, 4, etc.), not every 1 unit.
The description fails to mention what each line represents according to the legend (e.g., "БВП на един отработен човекочас по текущи цени" for the blue line).
The description does not mention the style of the lines (the blue line is dashed, the orange line is solid).
The phrase "на една година" (at one year) is unclear and incorrect. It should state the starting year, which is 2000.

The value for the blue line in 2003 is 6.73. The value 10.93 corresponds to the orange line in 2002.

The value for the blue line in 2017 is 17.66. The value 16.57 corresponds to the orange line in 2017.
The final value for the blue line in 2018 is 18.94. The value 17.09 is the final value for the orange line.
The markers for the orange line are circles, not squares.
